::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal" icon="false" title="Purpose"}
Use this guide with the Week 2 readings and class activities. Your completed
notes should help you select and interpret descriptive statistics based on the
question, variable type, and distribution.
:::

## Objectives

- choose appropriate measures of center and spread;
- identify the denominator used in a percentage;
- distinguish frequency, cross-tabulation, and grouped-summary tables;
- compare measures of association; and
- explain why a summary is or is not meaningful for a variable.

- [Descriptive Statistics](readings/descriptive-statistics.qmd)

- [Working with Percentages](readings/working-with-percentages.qmd)
- Week 2 slides and class examples

::: {.callout-tip appearance="minimal" icon="false" title="Expectations"}
This work is graded for thoughtful completion. Use your own examples and explain
the reasoning behind each choice rather than listing formulas alone.
:::
